name: marvyn
description: Marvyn reads your connected ads, website analytics, search, social and store data, returns calculated, reliability-checked answers, and prepares ad changes such as a new campaign, a pause or switching a campaign on. Nothing changes or spends until the account owner approves it.

interface.longDescription:
Marvyn reads the marketing data you have connected to your Marvyn workspace, answers questions about it with numbers Marvyn has already calculated, and prepares changes to your ads for you to approve.

What you can ask: how your marketing is doing overall; which ad campaigns and ads are working or wasting money (Meta, Google, Snapchat, Reddit and X ads); where your website funnel loses people; whether your conversion tracking can be trusted; why a number changed; and what to fix first.

What you can do: ask Marvyn to build a campaign on Meta, Google Ads or Reddit Ads, pause a campaign or ad, switch a paused campaign back on, launch a Meta campaign Marvyn created paused, or create a Meta audience. Marvyn prepares the change as a card and shows you exactly what will change and what it will spend. It is made on the ad platform only after the account owner approves it, either in Marvyn or by saying yes in this chat. Google and Reddit campaigns are always created paused; switching one on is a separate approval that shows its budget again.

Data sources: ad accounts, website analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Facebook and Instagram, and Shopify.

Reliability: every answer says how fresh the data is, which sources are missing, and which figures were withheld because there was not enough data behind them. Marvyn says "not enough data" rather than guessing.

Without an account: check whether AI crawlers can read any website (robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, llms.txt, sitemap and home page).

Who it is for: founders, marketers and agencies who use Marvyn (marvyn.io). Connecting uses your existing Marvyn account, and available features follow your Marvyn plan.

Limitations: Marvyn never changes, pauses, publishes or spends anything without the account owner's approval. Team members can read but cannot prepare or approve changes. It works only with the one Marvyn workspace you connect.
